# Dilemma v3.10.1

New quiz cards use the shorter penalty labels **Wrong: -N ✦** and **Błąd: -N ✦**. The badge is grouped beside the initial voting duration in the top-right corner. The same compact labels are used in alternative text and the text fallback. Penalty amounts are unchanged.

The **Report quiz / Zgłoś quiz** button is red in newly rendered active and closed quiz controls. Previously published image attachments keep their original appearance.

Review and synchronize the general Polish and English player guides. Dilemma posts these release highlights separately on registered guide channels. No database migration or Discord command registration is required when upgrading from v3.10.0.
